headlines.title: 3 Safe-and-Steady Stocks with Exciting Potential
headlines.summary: Stocks with low volatility can be a great foundation for a portfolio, especially for investors looking to reduce risk. While they don’t often make headlines, these companies provide consistency in an unpredictable market.

headlines.title: McDonald's (MCD) Could Be 1% Overvalued After Its Restaurant NEXT Push
headlines.summary: McDonald's (MCD) is pushing ahead with its Restaurant > NEXT overhaul, asking U.S. drive thru franchisees to commit about $800,000 per location to new technology and operational upgrades as some operators question the payoff. For shareholders, McDonald's recent announcement comes after a tougher period for the stock.

headlines.title: Starbucks (SBUX) vs McDonald’s (MCD) and Yum Brands (YUM): Which Restaurant Stock is a Better Buy?
headlines.summary: Starbucks Corporation (NASDAQ:SBUX) closed at $90.75 on October 9. description: McDonald's Corporation owns, operates, and franchises restaurants under the McDonald's brand in the United States and internationally. It offers food and beverages, including hamburgers and cheeseburgers, various chicken sandwiches, fries, shakes, frozen desserts, sundaes, soft serve cones, cookies, pies, soft drinks, coffee, and other beverages; and full or limited breakfast, as well as sells various other products during limited-time promotions. The company owns and operates franchised restaurants under various structures, including conventional franchise, developmental license, or affiliate. McDonald's Corporation was founded in 1940 and is based in Chicago, Illinois.
